# High School Seminar Preparation Sheet

Subject: ELA
Grade band: 9-12
Resource type: Discussion Organizer
NYS framework label: NYS Next Generation ELA Learning Standards

## Short Description
A seminar prep page for claims, textual evidence, follow-up questions, and listening goals.

## Alignment Note
Supports collaborative discussion, evidence use, and analysis of complex literary or informational texts.

## Classroom Use Case
Assign before Socratic seminars or fishbowl discussions to improve evidence-based participation.

## Preview Content
- My opening claim
- Text evidence with page or paragraph
- Question I can ask to extend the discussion

## Teacher Notes
This original StandardCraft resource is intended to support planning and classroom use. It is not issued by NYSED and does not replace district curriculum, local requirements, or teacher professional judgment.
